title: HR Administrator
description:
Temporary HR Advisor / Administrator

Location: Newbury (office-based )
Contract: Temporary
Start Date: ASAP for approx. 4-6 weeks whilst they recruit on a permanent basis
Hours: Full-time Monday to Friday 8.30am - 4.30pm ( they can be flexible on this )
Reporting to: HR Team / Business Leadership

Overview

We are seeking a proactive, resilient HR Advisor / Administrator to join a small, dynamic HR team based in Newbury on a temporary basis. This is a busy, hands-on advisory role supporting the business across the full employee lifecycle while a permanent HR Advisor is recruited.

This opportunity is ideal for an experienced HR professional who enjoys an operational environment, thrives at pace and is confident providing pragmatic HR advice. You will act as the first point of contact for managers, supporting a varied workforce and gaining exposure to all areas of HR.

Key Responsibilities
- Act as a trusted HR Advisor, providing confident, pragmatic guidance to managers and employees
- Support the business across the full employee lifecycle
- Manage a high-volume, end-to-end recruitment process across multiple business areas
- Deliver effective onboarding and support training and development initiatives
- Advise on and actively support employee relations matters including disciplinaries, grievances and performance management
- Support TUPE processes for both incoming and outgoing contracts
- Ensure compliance with UK employment legislation, company policies and HR best practice
- Carry out DBS checks for new and existing employees
- Maintain accurate and up-to-date HR records and systems
- Build strong relationships with operational teams, attending regular site visits

About You
- Previous experience in a hands-on HR Advisory or HR Administration role
- Confident communicator with the ability to influence and build credibility at all levels
- Highly organised, adaptable and comfortable working in a fast-paced environment
- Confident using HR systems and databases

If you have previous experience in a HR Advisor / HR Administrator role and are available to temp for the next 4-6 weeks then please apply online and I will screen your cv and contact you with more information if successful.

title: HR Assistant
description:
HR Assistant - Reading - Salary £30,000 to £32,000

About the Role

We're looking for a highly organised and proactive HR Assistant to join our clients team. This is a varied and rewarding role that sits at the heart of the employee experience, supporting colleagues throughout their journey with the business. From recruitment and onboarding through to training, payroll support and employee relations, you'll play an important role in ensuring our people processes run smoothly, efficiently and in line with employment legislation and company policies.

The successful candidate will be a strong administrator with excellent attention to detail, a professional approach to confidential information and a genuine passion for supporting people.

A bit about the day to day
- Managing and maintaining employee records and HR systems.
- Supporting recruitment activities, including onboarding and offboarding processes.
- Preparing employment documentation, letters and HR correspondence.
- Assisting with payroll administration and ensuring accurate data submission.
- Monitoring and maintaining holiday, absence and sickness records.
- Coordinating training programmes and compliance requirements.
- Responding to employee and manager queries in a timely and professional manner.
- Assisting with the development, review and maintenance of company policies and procedures.
- Supporting employee relations processes and associated administration.
- Producing reports and people-related statistics while maintaining strict confidentiality.
- Contributing to HR projects and the implementation of people initiatives across the business.

A bit about you
- A good understanding of HR processes and employment legislation.
- Excellent administrative and organisational skills.
- A professional, confidential and trustworthy approach.
- The ability to manage competing priorities and meet deadlines.
- Strong interpersonal skills and a customer-focused mindset.
- A proactive approach to problem-solving and continuous improvement.

Desirable
- Previous payroll administration experience or payroll knowledge.

HR Assistant - Reading - Salary £30,000 to £32,000

title: Learning & Development Advisor
company: Bucks and Berks Recruitment - Agency - Permanent
description:
Our client based in Maidenhead is currently recruiting for Learning and Development advisor to join their busy team on a 3 month contract. This is to cover sickness and is unlikely to be extended beyond the 3 months.

The role will be hybrid with 2-3 days per week in the office. There is parking available. Working hours are full time Monday to Friday 8.15am-5.15pm.

Key duties include:
- To lead on the development of a strong L&D culture throughout the organisation, finding innovative ways to inspire others and by leading with personal example.
- In conjunction with the People Services Manager, create the annual L&D plan to align learning to corporate priorities and identify annual budget requirements. This will include both renewal of regular planned/compliance learning activities within specified timescales, and partnering with managers throughout the organisation to proactively identify and forecast additional L&D needs.
- Take ownership for delivering the annual L&D plan so that activity is sourced to achieve learning objectives, organised, delivered and recorded on systems within agreed timescales and within agreed budget.
- Negotiate with external providers to ensure maximum value for money and programmes are highly tailored to the needs of the organisation.
- Research, design and deliver in-house innovative and engaging L&D programmes using a variety of methods to meet organisation specific L&D needs. Including but not limited to management development programme, induction, performance management processes, equality/diversity/inclusion, professional boundaries and customer service.
- Oversee the roll out of essential e-learning, monitor completion rates, and put measures in place to achieve 100% completion within target date.
- Proactively promote the L&D activities and successes to the organisation through regular and engaging communication utilising a variety of channels to engage all colleagues.
- Monitor and evaluate the implementation of learning outcomes to ensure learning is successful and value for money, making and implementing recommendations to further improve value of learning activities.
- Organise, be an ambassador for and lead on the recruitment for career development programmes such as apprenticeships, work experience and undergraduate placements to benefit both the individual and the organisation.
- Support managers throughout the organisation in planning and delivering an effective and professional induction and personal development plan for new joiners.
- Support managers to use the performance management framework effectively and work collaboratively with the People Services Manager to be the HR lead on key stages of the cycle, including setting SMART objectives, creation of personal development plans, and review processes.
- Ensure that systems are fully utilised to digitise and improve the efficiency of L&D processes.
- Support the Assistant Director of People Services in succession planning for the organisation.
- Provide effective line management and leadership for the Learning Coordinator, including setting objectives, PDP whilst overseeing all L&D administration to ensure accurate and efficient completion.
- Coach and support employees on an individual basis in response to their needs to improve performance.
- To take on other duties commensurate with this post as directed/delegated by the People Services Manager.

You must have existing experience within learning and development to be successful in this position

title: Recruitment Account Coordinator
description:
Permanent I Full-time I 5 out of 7 days I On-site

Salary: up to £30,000 per annum + bonus

Have you considered a career in recruitment? You possess drive, ambition, discipline, and structure, but haven't yet had the opportunity to put it all into practice? Come and showcase your potential at Staffline.

The Recruitment Account Opportunity

This is your chance to join the UK's largest recruitment business as a Recruitment Account Coordinator. In this role, you'll be providing temporary workers for our Driving operation in Reading.

To excel in this role, your focus will be on customers, committed to delivering the best service, and a natural problem solver. While experience in on-site recruitment would be beneficial, it's not an essential requirement. If you have transferable skills, we can provide training on all the elements essential for success in this position.

What you'll do as a Recruitment Account Coordinator

This role thrives on pace - helping candidates find the best jobs, solving problems, and enhancing the candidate experience and work environment. It's a wonderfully diverse role that will undoubtedly keep you engaged. Here's a glimpse of what you can expect:
- Meeting client deadlines by fulfilling staffing requirements
- Recruitment, selection, and onboarding of workers
- Accurate data input and validation for weekly payroll
- Handling administrative processes such as absences and change requests
- Ensuring compliance and maintaining secure records for audits
- Providing a positive customer experience and efficiently addressing worker queries

The skills you'll develop as a Recruitment Account Coordinator

Throughout your time at Staffline, you'll receive coaching and challenges that will facilitate skill growth. In this role, you can anticipate enhancing skills related to client and relationship management, hiring and staffing processes, and identifying opportunities for performance improvement - among a range of other areas. At Staffline, we actively encourage progression and personal development, with dedicated progression paths for those who join us.

What we need from you

By now, it should be evident that we're dedicated to your development, fair rewards, and encouraging you to excel in your role at Staffline. To succeed in this position, a few things are required:
- Swift adaptation to changing priorities and effective problem-solving skills
- A customer-centric mindset, prioritizing people above all else
- Ideally, experience within the recruitment industry (though not essential)
- A growth mindset, consistently seeking innovative approaches while fulfilling both client and customer needs
- Strong relationship-building abilities, confidently establishing and maintaining connections with clients and customers
- Most importantly, tenacity, drive, flexibility, and a positive attitude toward delivering excellent service.

Diversity and Inclusion: A Core Focus

At Staffline, we are deeply committed to building a diverse and inclusive workforce. We believe that a diverse team brings different perspectives, ideas, and experiences, enhancing our overall effectiveness and success. We value and celebrate the uniqueness of each individual, and we actively encourage applications from candidates of all backgrounds.

Intrigued? Why not apply now? Or if you need more information, get in touch.

Note: All candidates must demonstrate their Right to Work in the UK. A full UK driver's license is highly desired for this role.

title: Senior Recruitment Advisor - internal
company: Think Accountancy and Finance - Agency - Permanent
description:
Think Specialist Recruitment are partnering with a highly recognised global organisation in Colnbrook to appoint an experienced Senior Recruitment Advisor to support a fast-paced commercial team.

This is an opportunity for a confident, credible recruiter who thrives in high-volume environments and can operate as a true talent partner to senior stakeholders.

This will be a fully office-based role but there is some flexibility around the hours worked, so reduced hours will be considered for the right candidate.

Salary - £45-50,000 plus bonus and other benefits.

What You'll Be Responsible For
- Managing end-to-end recruitment across high-volume commercial and operational vacancies
- Partnering closely with hiring managers and senior stakeholders, including managing challenging and fast-moving recruitment demands
- Proactively sourcing talent through LinkedIn Recruiter and direct search methods
- Building strong pipelines of sales and customer-focused talent, particularly Account Managers and similar commercial profiles
- Advising stakeholders on market insight, attraction strategy, and hiring best practice
- Coordinating and conducting assessments and interviews
- Managing recruitment processes compliantly and efficiently within a regulated environment
- Supporting wider team with recruitment projects

What We're Looking For
- Strong in-house or agency recruitment background within a larger, fast-paced business
- Proven experience managing high-volume recruitment campaigns
- Demonstrable success sourcing candidates directly through LinkedIn Recruiter and other proactive methods
- Strong experience recruiting sales/commercial talent, including Account Managers or customer-facing roles
- Confident stakeholder manager with the ability to influence and challenge hiring managers where required
- Organised, resilient, and commercially minded approach
- Experience working within regulated or process-driven environments is advantageous

This is a fantastic opportunity for an experienced recruiter to join a truly collaborative team. We ideally are seeking recruiters/Talent Acquisition specialists who have managed vacancies within sales roles.

Think Human Resources is the HR division of Think Specialist Recruitment, an independently owned recruitment business. The HR division is responsible for recruiting permanent, temporary and contract roles within the field of Human Resources including; HR Administrator, HR Assistant, HR Advisor, HR Business Partner, HR Manager, Head of HR, Employee Relations, talent, internal recruitment, Learning and Development, Compensation and Benefits/Reward and Recognition.

title: Temporary Part-Time HR Admin - 12 Month Contract
description:
Temp Part-Time HR Administrator - 12 Months - 25 hours per week -

Slough - £13.00 Per Hour + Holiday Pay

About the Client

Our client is a well-established Local/Central Government organisation providing essential services to the community. With a supportive, collaborative culture and a strong sense of purpose, this is an excellent opportunity to join a welcoming HR team where professional development is encouraged.

About the Job

This is a fantastic opportunity for an organised and people-focused HR Administrator to join the team on a part-time basis, providing essential support across recruitment, onboarding and HR compliance. You'll play an important role in ensuring new employees have a smooth journey into the organisation, coordinating the necessary checks and documentation while working closely with candidates, hiring managers and external contacts.
- Coordinating pre-employment screening and onboarding for new starters
- Managing references, right-to-work, DBS and qualification checks
- Ensuring compliance with safeguarding and safer recruitment requirements
- Keeping candidates and hiring managers updated throughout onboarding
- Liaising with external providers to progress checks efficiently
- Maintaining accurate and confidential HR and recruitment records
- Following up on outstanding documentation and deadlines
- Providing general HR administration and a professional candidate experience

About the Successful Applicant

You'll be a highly organised HR Administrator with strong customer service skills and ideally previous exposure to HR or recruitment. You'll have excellent written and verbal communication skills, a keen eye for detail and the confidence to manage competing priorities and deadlines. A proactive, collaborative approach is important, alongside discretion when handling confidential information and a commitment to maintaining high standards.

What You Will Receive in Return

This is a great opportunity to gain further HR experience within a supportive, purpose-led organisation while enjoying the flexibility of a 25-hour working week. You'll benefit from training and development opportunities, flexible working policies, technology-supported agile working and a friendly, collaborative environment with supportive colleagues.

How to Proceed

To advance your next career move, please reach out to Lucy-Emma at Wade Macdonald today - (please call only if you have some previous HR, onboarding or recruitment, admin experience) . You can get in touch by promptly submitting your CV through the designated portal. Your next career move awaits!
